title: Durga Puja - Monali Thakur Live In Bay Area
description: Experience the Divine Durga Puja with Monali Thakur Live in the Bay Area
long_description:
Experience the Divine Durga Puja with Monali Thakur Live in the Bay Area
Immerse yourself in the heart-stirring beats of Bengali and Hindi music with the Durga Puja - Monali Thakur Live in Bay Area on the 17th of October, 2026. It's not just a live concert, it's a vibrant celebration of culture, tradition, and heartfelt music. This promises to be an unforgettable evening filled with the soulful voice of Monali, set against the backdrop of the grand Durga Puja festivities.
Monali Thakur: The Voice that Touches Hearts
Monali Thakur, born on the 3rd of November 1985 in Kolkata, India, is an esteemed Indian playback singer and actress. Her enchanting voice and charismatic stage presence have garnered her a dedicated fan base worldwide. Known for her flawless renditions in both Bengali and Hindi, she brings a unique blend of passion and energy to every performance. This event is a golden opportunity to witness her musical prowess in person.
Discover the Santa Clara County Fairgrounds
The event will be held at the Santa Clara County Fairgrounds, located at 344 Tully Rd, San Jose, CA, United States. This renowned venue is known for its safety, accessibility, and welcoming environment. Plus, it's surrounded by a variety of attractions that you can explore before or after the event. Parking won't be an issue as the venue provides ample space. For the foodies, there are numerous Indian restaurants nearby to satisfy your cravings.
Your Gateway to an Unforgettable Evening
Choose from a range of ticket options designed to enhance your experience. The VVIP ticket priced at $159 includes a Preferred Parking pass, Dinner (Veg and non-veg), and an exclusive Meet and Greet with Monali Thakur. The VIP ticket, priced at $129, offers Dinner (veg and non-veg). For those who wish to enjoy the concert from the front, tickets are available at $59, while the general back tickets are priced at $39. Secure your spot now for an evening filled with music, food, and unforgettable memories.
